resources.string: Google\'s handwriting recognition for Lychee\'s handwriting pad
Each model is about 20 MB, from Google\'s ML Kit. Opening this app checks for newer ones.
Not downloaded. Check the connection and open this app again

This app goes online to download Google\'s handwriting models. What you write is read on this phone and never sent anywhere. This app itself has no tracking, analytics or ads. Google\'s ML Kit, which it uses, sends Google figures about how it runs (such as the device model, the app\'s version and how long recognition took), as Google\'s terms require; never your handwriting. Lychee itself has no internet access at all.
Lychee keeps working. Open this screen again from Lychee: Settings › Add-ons › Google Handwriting. Some launchers take a moment to update.
